g.inkscape:label: Guides (locked)
g.text: One icon per cell, painted with the swatches below. Lucid
recolours them from your wallpaper and animates the parts
you name. This copy starts as Gravity, the default set.
Save as plain SVG and drop it into Icon Studio on the Lucid website.
It checks every cell, previews the set in a few palettes and packs
the .lucidicons file you share or install.
48 units, 4 of them padding. Keylines keep sizes even.
Paint only with these tones. Each is a key that Lucid swaps for the same tone of the wallpaper's palette.
A tone stays the same in light and dark mode, so an icon looks like itself in both; the light sheet shows these same keys on light surfaces.
What Lucid checks when it imports a sheet.
Fills are matched by exact colour. Any other
colour needs its own line in theme.json.
No outlines. A gradient is fine when both its
ends are swatches, lit from the top like the rest.
Inkscape: Path, Stroke to Path. Figma: Outline
stroke. Lucid only reads filled shapes.
Group a piece and name it, like front or emblem,
and it can animate on hover.
Everything in a cell belongs to that icon. Dashed
cells are optional; empty ones use Lucid's own.
Nothing sharper than 2 units. Soft corners are
what makes a set feel like Lucid.
tile 44 · a picture per app, the plate for the rest · duplicate a brand cell for any app id
circle 40 · shown at 16 on the corner · 4 cells, 2 optional
Lucid icon kit · sheet format 1 · October 2026
